name: agent-bus
description: Local message bus for coordinating Claude, Codex, Kimi, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other MCP-capable agent sessions on the same machine.
skillInstructions: agent-bus requires @agent-bus-connect/cli on PATH. If agent-bus MCP tools are missing or setup looks broken, run the bundled setup checker or ask the user to run: npm i -g @agent-bus-connect/cli@latest.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate multiple local AI coding sessions with team chat, tracked tasks, Kanban, memories, review gates, final reports, and a local web cockpit. Works across Claude, Codex, Kimi, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any MCP-capable client.
